name: We Energies Lakeshore Lateral

values.StartLocation: Bluff Creek Gate Station, La Grange

researcher_notes: A Wisconsin farm-agency impact statement from March 2021 (Wisconsin Public Service Commission case 6630-CG-138) says We Energies proposed about 46 miles of new 24 inch pipe in Walworth, Kenosha and Racine counties. The commission approved it in 2020. A news report from April 2021 says construction began in 2020 and completion was expected by the end of 2021. A Gazette newspaper article says the line starts at the Bluff Creek Gate Station in La Grange and ends in Mount Pleasant, at a cost of 174.1 million dollars for the route that was approved; the final route changed later, so the endpoints and cost are approximate. An earlier agency page calls the owner Wisconsin Gas LLC doing business as We Energies. No source found that says the line is in service, so status is construction, not operating; a person should check. Capacity was not found. No existing GEM row matches (the roster has only ANR and Vector projects in Wisconsin). Route not researched; official route maps are in the agency impact statements. The 7 mile Lakeshore Capacity Improvement line (case 6630-CG-137) is a separate project and not included. Length 46 miles is above the 25 km threshold.
